title: My Neighbour Kept Stealing My Mangoes 🥭
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #twist #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: Every single night, my neighbour stole mangoes from my tree. I had proof, but he always denied it.
scenes.image: a sneaky middle-aged neighbour with a bald head and a thin mustache, wearing a striped vest sneaking up a mango tree at night with a flashlight, a young man about 28 with messy brown hair and a green hoodie watching angrily from a window

scenes.text: So I put up a sign. Warning: the mangoes on this tree are poisonous.
scenes.image: a young man about 28 with messy brown hair and a green hoodie hammering a big wooden warning sign onto a mango tree trunk, smug face

scenes.text: The next morning, half the mangoes were gone again. And under my sign, someone had written: Thanks! Now nobody else will steal them.
scenes.image: a young man about 28 with messy brown hair and a green hoodie shocked, staring at the sign with a scribbled reply under it and a half-empty mango tree

scenes.text: I was furious. So that night, I changed the sign. It now said: Only one mango on this tree is poisoned.
scenes.image: a young man about 28 with messy brown hair and a green hoodie writing on a new sign by moonlight with an evil grin

scenes.text: The next morning I opened my door, and there was a basket on my doorstep.
scenes.image: a young man about 28 with messy brown hair and a green hoodie opening a front door in the morning and finding a big basket of mangoes on the doorstep

scenes.text: Every single mango he had ever stolen. With a tiny note on top: Which one?
scenes.image: close-up of a basket full of mangoes with a small handwritten note on top, a young man about 28 with messy brown hair and a green hoodie laughing

scenes.text: Here's the thing. I never poisoned a single mango.
scenes.image: a young man about 28 with messy brown hair and a green hoodie winking while biting into a mango

scenes.text: But to this day, my neighbour sniffs every fruit he eats. Even bananas.
scenes.image: a sneaky middle-aged neighbour with a bald head and a thin mustache, wearing a striped vest suspiciously sniffing a banana at his kitchen table, sweating
